set.body:
Source: plan phase 4b; split from P6f.18 so the release lands after the API churn.

Problem:
mimaPreviousArtifacts is Set() (verified 2026-07-26: zero git tags, nothing published), so mimaReportBinaryIssues in CI currently checks nothing. One of the four CI gates is a no-op, which also means the claim that a wire-breaking enum rename passed test plus mima plus scalafmt understated the situation: mima was vacuous by construction.

Must land AFTER P7.2 and P6f.12, because P7.2 changes Vector[Byte] in public signatures across nine modules and publishing a baseline before it would burn the baseline immediately.

Acceptance:
- Tag and publish 0.1.0 once the public API has settled.
- Verify mimaPreviousArtifacts is non-empty.
- Deliberately remove a public method and confirm CI fails, held to the same verify-by-breaking standard as P6f.28-P6f.39.

Blocked by P7.2 and P6f.12.
set.title: P7.6: Cut the compatibility baseline and prove the gate bites
